thread:
Maria Chen: Customer repro - tool_call returns 400 "Invalid tool args" when user pastes Windows path plus a copied text that includes an invisible bell.

Maria Chen: Repro payload pasted by customer:
```json
{
  "tool": "file_reader",
  "args": "{\"path\": \"C:\\\\Users\\\\alice\\\\Desktop\\\\report.txt\",\n            \"note\": \"Please review\u0007\",\n}"
```

Ajay Patel: Error from parser in logs: `SyntaxError: Unexpected token } in JSON at position 123` — looks like trailing comma + control char.

Lena Ortiz: Do we know which client produced that string? smartpaste from Windows can add CRLF+BEL when copying from terminals.

Maria Chen: Customer said they used curl on Windows: 
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/toolcall \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d "{\"tool\":\"file_reader\",\"args\":\"{\\\"path\\\": \\\"C:\\\\\\\\Users\\\\\\\\alice\\\\\\\\Desktop\\\\\\\\report.txt\\\\", \\\"note\\\": \\\"Please review\\u0007\\\",}\"}"
```

Ajay Patel: That -d string double-encodes and the trailing comma inside the inner JSON will break our schema validation. Also the embedded \ may trigger our sanitization path.

Jen Ops: Can you attach the request_id and client User-Agent? we'll attach logs to ESCL ticket.

Maria Chen: request_id=rr-20240305-9f3b
User-Agent: curl/7.83.1 on Windows-10
Attached snippet from our validator: `validate_tool_args: json.loads failed at position 89 - 'ControlCharacterError'`.

Lena Ortiz: Short-term workaround: strip control chars and reject trailing commas before sending to our API. Long-term: SDK should normalize pasted strings. Can support team patch the customer curl example with proper escaping and advise them to use --data-binary or a file.

Maria Chen: Sent patched example to customer and they confirmed success when using file @payload.json (no inline paste). Customer happy. 

support-bot: :rotating_light: Escalation created ESCL-3581 -> eng-runtime (priority P2). Linked ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ESCL-3581

Ajay Patel: Assigning to @Lena Ortiz for initial triage, will add unit test for control-char removal + schema parser change.

Lena Ortiz: I'll own the PR. Plan: add pre-parse sanitizer, add testcases for CRLF+BELL and trailing-comma, and a warning in SDK docs. ETA EOW.

Maria Chen: Thanks team :+1: Customer notified and ticket updated.
